lamps.steady: Informs the driver and passengers that seat belts are not fastened when driving under 20 km/h or stopped.
lamps.flashing: Blinks and chimes for approximately 100 seconds (or 35 seconds for rear) when driving 20 km/h and faster without seat belts.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when there is a malfunction with the SRS. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.

lamps.lamp: Parking brake & Brake fluid warning light
lamps.steady: Illuminates when the parking brake is applied or brake fluid level is low. Stop safely, check fluid, and inspect brakes.
Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the ABS. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD) system warning light
lamps.steady: Illuminates simultaneously with ABS and Parking Brake warnings when there is a problem with the EBD system.
Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the electric power steering. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.
Illuminates when there is a malfunction with the alternator or electrical charging system. Stop safely and check drive belt.
Illuminates when engine oil pressure is low. Stop vehicle immediately, turn engine off, and check oil level.
Illuminates when the engine oil level should be checked. Stop safely, turn engine off, and check oil level.
Illuminates when engine coolant temperature is extremely high. Do not continue driving; refer to overheating procedures.
Illuminates when the fuel tank is nearly empty. Add fuel as soon as possible.
Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the emission control system, engine, or vehicle powertrain.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when an engine control system error occurs on diesel engines, which could result in loss of power.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when water has accumulated inside the diesel fuel filter. Have water removed by an authorized dealer.
Illuminates when accumulated soot reaches a certain amount. Drive above 80 km/h for 30 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if GPF system has a malfunction. Have the GPF system checked by an authorized dealer.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when there is a malfunction with the DPF system. Drive above 60 km/h for 30 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if DPF system error persists. Have the DPF system checked by an authorized dealer.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when the urea solution tank is nearly empty. Refill urea solution as soon as possible.
Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the EPB. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.
Illuminates yellow whenever there is a malfunction with the Auto Hold function.
Illuminates when one or more tires are significantly underinflated. Stop and check tires.
lamps.flashing: Blinks for approximately 60 seconds or in 3-second intervals when there is a malfunction with the TPMS.

lamps.steady: Illuminates continuously yellow when Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist is Off, Disabled, or Malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks red when Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist is operating.

lamps.steady: Illuminates yellow whenever there is a malfunction with Lane Keeping Assist.

lamps.flashing: Blinks when you drive the vehicle more than 120 km/h to prevent over speeding, accompanied by a chime.

lamps.steady: Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the 4WD system. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.
Illuminates when you select 4WD Lock mode by pressing the 4WD LOCK button to increase drive power.
Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the LED headlight.
lamps.flashing: Blinks whenever there is a malfunction with a LED headlight related part.

lamps.steady: Illuminates whenever there is a malfunction with the ESC system.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) OFF indicator light
lamps.steady: Illuminates when you deactivate the ESC system by pressing the ESC OFF button.
Illuminates when the vehicle detects the key/smart key in the ON/ACC position, allowing the engine to start.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when there is a malfunction with the immobilizer system or when the smart key is not in the vehicle.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when the diesel engine is being preheated. Start engine after the light goes off.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if there may be a malfunction with the engine preheating system while driving or after warming up.

lamps.steady: Illuminates yellow whenever there is a malfunction with the Downhill Brake Control system.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when the Downhill Brake Control system is operating.

lamps.steady: Illuminates white when the engine enters the Idle Stop mode of the ISG system and automatically starts.

lamps.flashing: Blinks when you operate the turn signal stalk. Rapid blinking or no blinking indicates a system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when headlamps are on and in high beam position or when pull into Flash-to-Pass position.
Illuminates when the headlamps are on.
Illuminates when the position lamps or headlamps are on.
Illuminates when the rear fog lamps are on.
Illuminates white when High Beam Assist is ready and green when operating with high-beam on.
Illuminates when cruise control is enabled.
Illuminates when you select SPORT mode as your drive mode.
Illuminates when you select ECO mode as your drive mode.
Illuminates when there is a malfunction in operation in systems like Forward Safety, Blind-Spot, LED headlamp, HBA, SCC, or TPMS.
